windows.title: OptiCull RAW & Lytro Illum 4D Studio (Early Alpha v0.1.0-alpha.1)

bundle.shortDescription: Offline AI Photo Culling, Lytro Illum 4D Light Field Refocus & XMP Sidecar Studio
bundle.longDescription: Early-stage open-source cross-platform desktop application built with Rust, ONNX Runtime, and Tauri v2 for batch photo culling, Laplacian sharpness scoring, Lytro Illum 4D (.LFR) light-field refocusing, and non-destructive Adobe XMP sidecar generation.
